PASSOVER, §§ 9, 12 ); compare Lev 20:5 (H), 25:10 , 41 (P), 25:49 (P; defined as בְּשָׂרוֺ מִשְּׁאֵר ), non-Hebrew 25:47 (H), 25:45 (P), Judg 1:25 ; מִשְׁמְּחוֺתֶיהָ Josh 6:23 (E or R) is unintelligible, probably strike out (compare Steuern Holz; אָבִיהָ בֵּית in 6:25 [J]), compare Num 27:4 , 11 (P); ׳מ אִמּוֺ אֲבִי בֵּית Judg 9:1 clan of his mother's father-house ; including individuals, and included by שֵׁבֶט 1Sam 9:21 (twice in verse); 10:21 ; with specific name, in series שֵׁבֶט ׳מ, בַּיִת, גֶבֶר, Josh 7:14 (twice in verse); 7:17 b, c (all J; 7:17 a read plural Di Benn, or שֵׁבֶט GFM Judg 13:2 ; Steuern allows either); compare Deut 29:17 ; Judg 21:24 , ׳מ בְּיִשׂ ׳אָבִי 1Sam 1:18 (+ חַיַּי , see II [ חַי ]; ׳אִישׁמִ֗֗֗מּ בֵּיתשָֿׁאוּל 2Sam 16:5 ; with name also Ruth 2:1 , 3 and (non-Israel) Job 32:2 . b. in loose, popular sense= tribe , Judg 13:2 ; 17:7 ; 18:19 , compare 18:2 (|| שֵׁבֶט 18:1 ), 18:11 (yet in these two read possibly plural, see GFM). c. techn. divisions of people of Israel Num 11:10 (J) Jer 2:4 ; 31:1 ; compare 3:14 ; Num 1:2 , 18 ; 2:34 ; 33:54 (all P), so (post-exilic) Neh 4:7 : Est 9:28 ( דּוֺר ׳מ, מְדִינָה, ). d. usually (P) technical divisions of tribes of Israel , Exod 6:14-15 , 25 ; Num 3:15 112t. Numbers (93 t. Numbers 26, including 3:43 where הַשּׁוּחָמִי apparently = Dan), 34 t. Joshua 13-21; also 1Chr 6:4 ; 6:45 ; 7:5 ; Zech 12:13 ; division of Gershom, etc. (in Levi) Num 3:18-19 , 20 41 t.
